title: Harder variant: three male voices (two detectives and the suspect), same words

facts.label: The back door was pried open with a crowbar
The cash drawer was left open

turns: Okay, Calvin. This is Detective Rowe. We're recording this, and you're free to leave at any time. Do you understand?
Tell me where you were last Thursday night.
I was home most of the night. Then I went out for a drive because I couldn't sleep.
Just around town. Down Harbor Street, past the marina.
Harbor Street. That's where the pharmacy is. Somebody broke into it that night.
I heard about that. I don't know anything about it.
What time were you out driving?
Late. It was around two in the morning, I think.
We know the back door was pried open with a crowbar. Do you own a crowbar, Calvin?
In my garage, I guess. I use it for work.
The pharmacy has an alarm. It never went off. Why do you think that is?
Maybe somebody cut the wire. That's what people do, right? You cut the alarm wire first.
That's an interesting thing to say. Nobody told you about the alarm wire.
I'm just guessing. I watch a lot of crime shows.
A neighbor saw a white pickup truck parked behind the store. You drive a white pickup, don't you?
Yeah, I do. But lots of people have white trucks.
And the camera across the street shows a man carrying a gray backpack.
I have a gray backpack. Everybody has a gray backpack.
The cash drawer was left open. Did you open the cash drawer?
No. I never touched any drawer. I wasn't in there.
Calvin, it will go a lot easier if you're honest with me.
I am being honest. I drove around and I went home.
Okay. We'll take a break here. It's three fifteen in the afternoon.
